# Branding prompts

Tool: built-in image generation. Existing project logos were edit targets; ts-expressor supplied the shared palette and social-card design reference. Logos preserve transparency. Social cards are exported to JPEG without changing their generated 2:1 layout.

## Logo alignment

Use case: precise-object-edit / logo-brand.
Edit target: image 1, the existing Laravel Rulecraft logo: a bold capital R with branching-rule nodes cut out in negative space. Image 2 is STYLE AND PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY: the ts-expressor logo.
Keep the exact recognizable R silhouette, branch graph shape, circular node cutouts, clean thick geometry and balanced proportions from image 1. Change its red color to the same professional blue #28518D used in image 2. Flatten its fill to a uniform opaque blue, remove mottled texture or stray artifacts, and make all edges crisp and polished. Preserve transparent node cutouts and the transparent background. Do not add lettering, arrows, tiles, outlines or extra decorations.
Square canvas; one centered mark with consistent generous margins, similar scale to the reference logo. Actual alpha transparency outside the icon, no background fill, no shadows, glow, gradients, blur or watermark.
This is the same Rulecraft identity, aligned to Thura Aung's portfolio and sibling developer-tool brand family.

## Social preview

Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: GitHub social-preview banner, full-bleed 2:1 landscape, ideally 1280 x 640.
Create the Laravel Rulecraft member of a coordinated open-source brand family by Thura Aung.
Input 1 is the exact freshly recolored Rulecraft logo: keep its capital R silhouette and branching-node negative spaces, blue #28518D. Input 2 is the authoritative sibling social card to match: replicate its soft cool-gray #EDF0F3 background, navy #25313D headings, blue accents, pale-blue subtitle panel, generous margins, clean sans-serif typography, author label, left text / right logo balance, and bottom blue capsule plus repository URL. Do not copy the TypeScript logo or ts-expressor copy.
Layout: large Rulecraft mark on the right third, left two thirds for copy, 64px safe margins. A complete single banner; no mockup. Keep the title on one line if possible while leaving room for the logo.
Exact text:
Upper-left label: "THURA AUNG / OPEN SOURCE"
Large headline: "Laravel Rulecraft"
Blue subtitle inside pale-blue panel: "Laravel business rules"
Supporting line: "Nested groups · Permissions · Visual builder"
Blue capsule: "Database-backed policies"
Footer: "github.com/thuraaung2493/laravel-rulecraft"
Accurate text, generous whitespace, no extra text, badges, version claims or watermark. No black background, red accents, decorative circuitry, glow, blur or shadows beyond the sibling's subtle inset-panel treatment.
